setupHelp: Use the short-lived token printed by the installer to create the installation owner.
releaseHelp: Experimental foundation release. Network provisioning, sales and bot workflows are being delivered in the next stages.
unavailable: Unavailable or waiting for a fresh observation
diagnosticsHelp: Check database and cache access from the I/O worker, or run a CPU check in the separate process worker. Refresh to see the persisted result.
scheduleHelp: Changes apply without restarting. Disabling delivery pauses queued work. Disabling heartbeats makes readiness unavailable after the last observation expires.
